hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 tools/meeting-notes/sync_gemini_notes.py 2>&1 | tail -30; mkdir -p graphify-out; if command -v graphify >/dev/null && graphify update . > graphify-out/last-update.log 2>&1; then echo '[graphify] code graph updated'; else echo '[graphify] UPDATE FAILED - see graphify-out/last-update.log'; fi; W=$(stat -f %m graphify-out/wiki/index.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0); G=$(stat -f %m graphify-out/graph.json 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ $((G - W)) -gt 604800 ]; then echo '[graphify] WARNING: wiki is >7 days older than graph.json - run /graphify . --update --wiki --no-viz to refresh'; fi

[ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. For architecture/feature work, consult graphify-out/wiki/index.md and GRAPH_REPORT.md (god nodes + community structure) before exploring raw files."}}' || true
